name: Garlic and ginger for high blood pressure
what_people_do: People with hypertension take raw garlic or ginger, in food or water, alongside or instead of tablets.
why_they_say_it_works: Garlic is believed to thin the blood and lower pressure; ginger to warm and open the vessels.

documented_by.source: Amira OC, Okubadejo NU 2007, BMC Complement Altern Med, PMID 17903257
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Lagos tertiary hypertension clinic: of 88 CAM users, garlic was the most common product (69.3%), then native herbs 25%, ginger 23.9%, bitter leaf 9.1%.

evidence.tested: Garlic for the common cold (the one garlic claim I could grade)
evidence.finding: Insufficient evidence; I did not search garlic for blood pressure.

source.name: Garlic for the common cold, Cochrane 2014, PMID 25386977

harm_note: Authors advise clinicians to ask about and counsel on CAM use; garlic and ginger effects on BP tablets not read.
gaps: Garlic and ginger for blood pressure not searched (to-do).
